info.name: BigCommerce Abandoned Cart Emails Checkout Token API

params.name: checkoutId
params.description: ID of the checkout; the same as the cart ID.

items.docs:
Use the checkout token to display a confirmation page for a guest shopper.
**Usage Notes** * The response from performing this POST request is a checkout token. * The checkout token is a single-use token that is not order-dependent.
